Name: Dana D
Bio: I am a registered dietitian and certified health coach with a variety of experiences and areas of expertise based on my 13 years of experience counseling patients and families on nutrition. I support my patients (of ALL ages) in making changes at a pace that is comfortable for them and help when it's time to dig in to discover inner motivation. My patients tell me they love my conversational demeanor and practical approach to nutrition, and I thoroughly enjoy helping them discover the eating style that will help them feel comfortable, thrive in health, and succeed in all areas of life.

Name: Melissa H
Bio: I am a nutritional therapist, yoga therapist, and health educator who believes in lifestyle therapy. I advocate for the healing modalities of real food nutrition and mindful yoga. I support each person individually with the care and guidance they deservce to activate their mind and body's innate capacity to heal.

Name: Nasira C
Bio: Nasira is a registered dietitian, fitness expert, and nutrition educator. She was drawn to nutrition and public health as a result of her diverse background in science, fine arts, and fitness. Nasira was a classical ballet dancer and trained with Pacific Northwest Ballet in Seattle, WA, the University of Arizona School of Dance in Tucson, AZ, and attended ABT Summer Intensives in New York. Upon graduating Summa Cum Laude from the University of Arizona with a B.S. in Nutrition and a B.F.A. in dance, Nasira continued her pursuit of a nutrition career and obtained a Master’s in Public Health from UCLA and a Doctorate in Nutritional Sciences from Loma Linda University. Nasira is a certified personal trainer and NASM and Senior Fitness Specialist, as well as a certified yoga instructor.  In addition to being a private practice registered dietitian, Nasira serves as the nutritionist for the ABT Gillespie School at Segerstrom Center for the Arts, the Chapman University School of Dance, AMDA College of Performing Arts, and Vivante on the Coast Senior Community.
